title: If φ(x) ≔ x is a page of this site, and ξ(x) ≔ x is the page you asked for, then
text: Since no x fulfils both conditions (in other words, Error 404), your request has left the state space of this site. Every orbit, however, lies in the basin of attraction of something: write a word below, and the flow will carry you to the pages that lie closest to it.

figure.label: Orbits leaving a saddle
figure.caption: Live: orbits of x′ = x, y′ = −y near a saddle at the origin. They arrive along the vertical axis and leave along the horizontal one, as your request arrived here and now has to leave.

scene.system:
x' = x
y' = -y
init x = 0
init y = 0
range x = [-1, 1]
range y = [-1, 1]
